This successor retains the full 1,076-target CON.09 lineage and adds only the 683 newly classified CON.10 outputs, with current bytes bound for all 1,759 targets. Nine previously active CON.09 outputs changed under the authorized new sources and are rebound only in this successor; the immutable CON.09 record remains unchanged. Shared package identities, dependency closure, generator versions, and licence obligations are unchanged. Independent exact-head review and hosted CI remain required before merge.
